Axiom: Discovery is design-blind to repository code (per `AX_SPEC_IS_SOLE_SOURCE`) **except** inside the External Dependencies Audit step, where narrow Read is permitted **only for inventory verification** — confirming whether a referenced package, file, scope, or tool physically exists. Permitted reads there: `package.json` and equivalents, `tsconfig.json` and equivalents, `specs/README.md`, sibling scope manifests, filesystem existence checks. Forbidden there: reading application source code to influence design decisions — inventory verification answers "does X exist", never "how does X work internally". An existing mechanism this audit turns up — one the spec should extend instead of duplicating — MUST feed back into the design: revising Architecture / Contracts on that finding is the ordinary continuation of THIS session's drafting, not a separate ceremony, as long as the spec has not yet merged to master (`AX_PIVOT_REQUIRES_SUPERSESSION` governs a revision raised after that point). Pop back to the relevant earlier step explicitly, incorporate the finding, then re-run the External Dependencies Audit once more before writing the final spec.
